requirements.title: Status is computed from evidence and real code changes

criteria.text: A requirement with evidence older than its code reports stale
A declared verified without evidence reports unverified

requirements.title: Evidence is indexed from both agent-neutral roots

criteria.text: Files named R<n>-*.md or R<n>.<i>-*.md link to that requirement
The tier word is read from the body

requirements.title: MCP server speaks stdio JSON-RPC 2.0 with 8 tools

criteria.text: initialize, tools/list and tools/call answer with the request id
A failing tool returns isError true instead of killing the server

requirements.title: CLI mirrors the core and gates CI

criteria.text: import-spec reads R<n> headings and 验收/Accept bullets
report --strict exits 1 unless every requirement is verified

requirements.title: Registry writes are atomic and tolerant of damaged logs

criteria.text: A corrupt decisions line does not hide the others
Requirement ids are validated as R<n>

requirements.title: Evidence can declare the requirements it proves

criteria.text: A projtruth: directive links a file under any name
A directive overrides the filename prefix

requirements.title: report --changed scopes the report to touched requirements

criteria.text: Only requirements whose file scope matches the change are listed
Untouched requirements that are not verified stay visible

requirements.title: The commit guard refuses to invalidate verified evidence

criteria.text: A staged source change without staged evidence blocks the commit
Already stale requirements never block, and no registry means no guard
